title: Chilli Pilaf with Red Kissed Cheese
description: A flavourful and easy-to-make pilaf dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. The red chilli adds a nice kick and the kissed cheese adds a delightful twist.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the red chilli and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pilaf and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the kissed and cook for another minute, stirring frequently.
Add the cheese and stir until melted.
